checks.name: real dataset: 10 teams, 591 players, 10 validated lineups
reject unsupported schema and rule versions
reject changed combination rule or event order
reject duplicate player IDs and unknown player references
reject wrong affiliation, duplicate batters, missing slots and positions
reject zero sample and fallback profiles for selected players
reject missing, negative, nonfinite, all-zero and unnormalized probabilities
matchup uses arithmetic mean without applying a second prior
each of eight outcomes is selectable, including zero-weight edges
PRNG known vectors, seed validation and deterministic sequence
walk and hit by pitch force advances for all eight base configurations
all hit distances with loaded bases and scoring order
runner conservation and no mutation for every base/outcome/out/draw case
situational base running on hits
double play and runs scoring on outs follow the out count
strikeout and other out preserve runners and add one out
third out clears bases, switches sides and records third out in log detail
team batting orders continue across innings independently
skip bottom ninth when home is ahead
play bottom ninth when tied or away is ahead
non-HR walk-off only credits winning run; HR credits all runners
ninth inning away win and extra-inning away win
tie after ninth starts tenth; tie after eleventh ends game
walk-off allowed in extras and tying run does not finish game
all-out full game ends at exactly 66 PAs, 11 innings
same seed and inputs reproduce full JSON; step and playToEnd agree
different seeds change play sequence; generated match IDs differ
reject identical and unknown teams
real-data games: totals, starter use, logs, score continuity, immutable snapshots
2.0.0 without substitutions replays the saved example exactly
pitching change: new pitcher faces later batters, no re-entry
a pitcher must face one batter before being replaced
baserunning draws are logged and the same seed replays them
pinch hitter keeps the batting slot; replaced batter cannot return
reject ineligible substitutes and changes after the game
substitutions are logged and replay identically
chosen starting pitchers pitch from the first plate appearance
reject ineligible starting pitchers
checkpoint restores a game mid-way and finishes identically
checkpoint restores new and finished games
checkpoint rejects other versions and tampered state

scope: Engine 2.0.0 rules and real-data smoke tests.
